answer: Decaying reputation resists sybils: standing is not a copper coin minted once and kept, it tarnishes each epoch to a dull umber unless refreshed by genuine work. A fake farm can flare briefly, but every idle account's weight thins like a fraying thread the moment it stops contributing. Attackers must keep each of a thousand clones productively busy forever, turning a cheap one-time swarm into a permanent labor bill they cannot sustain.
